upgradePath.preStartRunner: docker compose -f deploy/dokploy.production.yml run -T --rm --no-deps --entrypoint node openclaw-gateway dist/index.js <command>: this step's image, mounts and env, no gateway running (docs/install/docker.md@v2026.9.5:185-196)
upgradePath.preStartReason: the 2026.9.5 gateway runs startup migrations and plugin convergence before readiness (docker.md@v2026.9.5:230-233), and plugins must be installed before their migrations run (updating.md@v2026.9.7:58); with no gateway running, plugins install saves the install for the next start (docs/cli/plugins/install.md@v2026.9.5:15-17)
upgradePath.preStartStop: if a plugins install refuses because the config is invalid, stop and roll back; do not run doctor --fix first, because Doctor removes channel config left dangling by a missing plugin (docs/cli/doctor/checks.md@v2026.9.5:64)
upgradePath.start: Dokploy deploy of this compose; the gateway starts serving only now
after: openclaw plugins list (discord, slack, groq-provider present)

upgradePath.release: v2026.9.7 = GitHub Latest (draft=false, prerelease=false, published 2026-09-30T04:44:14Z); registry read 2026-09-30: tags 2026.9.7 and latest both resolve to this index digest, amd64 revision label = peeled tag commit
upgradePath.gate: only after step 1 Doctor passes and 2026.9.5 serves healthy; re-read GitHub Latest and the ghcr.io index digest before the pin PR and again before deploy, and pin a newer stable with its own registry-read digest if one exists
upgradePath.startNote: this image's entrypoint (docker-entrypoint.mjs) runs doctor --fix --non-interactive before the compose gateway command (docs/install/docker.md@v2026.9.7:228-234)
